annotations.title: Agent readiness report for a domain

description: Agent readiness report for a domain. Use when a task needs to know what an AI agent can actually do on a domain: llms.txt, robots rules for AI crawlers, sitemap, OpenAPI, an MCP endpoint, x402 or MPP offers, agent-commerce manifests (UCP, ACP, A2A) and structured data, with a score and a specific fix for each gap. Cost: 3 credits per call.

domain.description: The domain to check. A URL is accepted and its host is used.
